split_strategies.proof_of_InsertObj_return_wit_1_split_go: For mixed OSHeap/root-heap assertions use crtos_heap_lift_sep and crtos_heap_lift_entails plus unfolding of OSHeap, crtos_heap_state and primitive stores to transport the same concrete heap; OSHeap_ushort_eq is public. Do not assume the Local OSHeap_* lemmas are exported. Any additional carrier equality must be an inline assertion in this witness body, since no case lib exists. Let k=id mod hoffset sm, n=Build_IdNodeAbs id idnode_pre and new_bucket=n::bucket. Fold the id UShort and idnode_pre<>0 into store_idnode at link=idnode_pre+4. Use DLL.dllseg_shift_rev_contact_a to prefix n to the existing reverse-shifted segment, using the two updated next/prev cells. Combine its new first-prev=head cell with DLL.dllseg_shift_rev_to_dllseg, obtaining the tail pointer and head-prev resource; retain head-next=link and fold store_dll/store_idnodes. Derive tail nonzero by induction/list-last cases on the reconstructed nonempty dllseg and idnodes_nonzero of the new list (a pointer value cell alone does not imply nonzero); head and new-link nonzero are explicit. Apply store_idbuckets_replace to the unchanged except frame with k>=0 from positive hoffset. Prove idbuckets_ok for replace_Znth k new_bucket old_buckets as inline pure assertions: length unchanged; id is in range and absent from old ids by min_free_id/query=false; old permutation implies absence in every old bucket; extend idlist_ok and the selected idnodes_ok using idnode_pre<>0; preserve other buckets and bucket-index equations, adding id mod hoffset=k; prove concat/map permutation equals id::old_ids by the prefix/selected/suffix decomposition (commute the new singleton past prefix). Fold idmanager_link(idmanager_add before id), store_idmanager, and cancel the unchanged manager fields and already updated bitmap. No protocol-state transition is involved; only the abstract manager changes from allocated-unlinked to linked.

witnesses.name: proof_of_InsertObj_entail_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: For mixed OSHeap/root-heap assertions use crtos_heap_lift_sep and crtos_heap_lift_entails plus unfolding of OSHeap, crtos_heap_state and primitive stores to transport the same concrete heap; OSHeap_ushort_eq is public. Do not assume the Local OSHeap_* lemmas are exported. Any additional carrier equality must be an inline assertion in this witness body, since no case lib exists. Choose the left whole-goal disjunct. Unfold allocated_unlinked and store_sem_id_detached. Expose min_free_id, idbuckets_ok and the four manager fields, updated bitmap, id value and two detached link cells. Derive 0<=id<=65535 from id UShort validity (or min-free-id and idmax field range); positive hoffset from idbuckets_ok and upper bound from its UShort cell. Forget previous/next contents to undef with their actual values as witnesses, frame all other resources, and reassemble the conjunction. No existential state change.

Set k=id mod hoffset sm and bucket=Znth k (idbuckets before) nil. From 0<hoffset and the length component of idbuckets_ok obtain 0<=k<Zlength buckets. Lift store_idbuckets_split, retain the except frame, and use store_idbucket_cases. For the uninitialized alternative choose the left disjunct with empty bucket and zero head fields; prove head<>0 from validity of head.node_prev at offset zero. For initialized DLL choose the right disjunct with its actual hn,hp and nonzero facts. Frame manager, bitmap, id and undef links unchanged. All other pure conjuncts are original premises or the reflexive computed-head equation.
